Improving your company profile score can significantly enhance your overall worth score and business reputation. Here are some actionable steps you can take:

1. **Diversify Revenue Streams:**
   - Explore new markets or product lines to reduce dependency on a single revenue source.
   - Consider partnerships or collaborations to expand your offerings.

2. **Enhance Market Position:**
   - Invest in marketing and branding to increase your market presence.
   - Participate in industry events and networks to boost visibility and credibility.

3. **Expand Operational Scale:**
   - Open new locations or expand existing ones to increase your geographical footprint.
   - Hire additional employees to support growth and improve operational efficiency.

4. **Improve Credit Bureau Information:**
   - Ensure timely payments to suppliers and creditors to maintain a positive credit history.
   - Regularly review your credit reports for any discrepancies and address them promptly.

5. **Optimize Business Structure:**
   - Evaluate your business entity type (e.g., LLC, Corporation) to ensure it aligns with your growth goals and offers the best advantages.
   - Consider restructuring if it provides better tax benefits or operational efficiencies.

6. **Increase Revenue:**
   - Implement strategies to boost sales, such as promotions, discounts, or loyalty programs.
   - Focus on customer retention and satisfaction to drive repeat business.

7. **Strengthen Online Presence:**
   - Maintain an updated and professional website.
   - Engage with customers on social media platforms to build a strong online community.

8. **Gather and Showcase Positive Reviews:**
   - Encourage satisfied customers to leave positive reviews on platforms like Google, Yelp, and industry-specific sites.
   - Address any negative reviews constructively to demonstrate your commitment to customer satisfaction.

By focusing on these areas, you can improve your company profile score, which will positively impact your overall worth score and business health.

question.text: What's the best drink to order here?

answer.text: When I go for bottomless mimosas and sangrias my fave is the white sangria. I also love the passion fruit mimosa!

summary.snippet: "We also ordered the tuna and mango ceviche with these crispy fried chips."
"Great atmosphere, location, food, drinks and service."
"The small plates had an arrangement of options from meats, cheese, and spreads."

most_relevant.description: We dined in for a leisurely lunch and got the appetizer and meal combo for $21, and the lavender margarita! Everything tasted amazing and the presentstion and portions were awesome! Spinach salad, the best burger Ive ever had, and my friend got the kale salad and salmon over spinach and garbanzo beans. Sam was our server and made the experience perfect from start to finish. His suggestions and timing were spot on; with a great attitude toob. We shared a dessert - coconut flan with passion fruit sorbet. I'm so impressed  & couldn't ask for better! I can hardly wait to come back again.

I’ve been here several times, and it’s always been good, but today was exceptional thanks to Justin. Despite being incredibly busy, running between the bar and tables, he delivered excellent service with patience and attention to detail. After today, I truly understand what five-star service means, and it definitely goes to Justin. Thank you for pampering us and providing such outstanding service!

Came here for happy hour, stayed for dinner. We had a large party, and reservation was made for way less people than we ended up having. Management and staff went above and beyond to ensure we are taken care of and moved us to a larger table, during a peak rush hour with practically an entire restaurant being sat! 10/5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Service at the bar was fast and good.
Once we moved to the table, our server handled our party (12) by himself and was on top of refills and such! Food came out exactly how it was ordered. Super pleased with this experience.
Most importantly the happy hour here is amazing. I would say the best selection and prices that I have seen anywhere else! *Happy hour food applies only at the bar!
Will most definitely return!
Gladys was amazing! Super friendly and took great care of us. She made our dining experience really enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Frankly this is one of the best Spanish places we’ve tried in the US, and we travel a lot.
The staff is super well trained and organized. Make sure you make a reservation and, if Magic Dinners are available, take them.

We had a ton of stuff and you won’t be disappointed with anything, though we liked the croquetas (both ham and mushrooms), meat, flan, and churros the best.

We celebrated two anniversaries and will definitely be coming again (to get the paella) and recommending to others. For sure a must if in Winter Park.

Good place for Spanish-inspired tapas, but nothing is amazing. Maybe I'm just not a huge fan of Spanish food, but several items seemed too heavy or salty. My favorite were the montaditos. Service was friendly, and food came out at a good pace. Prices were a bit high for the quality.

We stopped by for the Labor Day brunch special, it was our first time here. Our server Ybar was great! The host was so nice as well, although I didn’t catch her name.
The $31pp prix fixe menu had a lot of great options but we finally decided on the watermelon salad, smoked salmon montaditos, steak & eggs, braised pork hash, torrija, and hazelnut waffles. Plus bottomless mimosa and a mango mule mocktail. Everything was delicious 😋
We will definitely be back!!

Great food and great service are a recipe for a great evening. Sam, Caroline and Frank were fabulous. They were fun, professional, made great drinks and were on top of our food and drinks orders. We had a very enjoyable evening with wonderful drinks and great tapas. The Moscow mule is awesome!

most_relevant.description: We dined in for a leisurely lunch and got the appetizer and meal combo for $21, and the lavender margarita! Everything tasted amazing and the presentstion and portions were awesome! Spinach salad, the best burger Ive ever had, and my friend got the kale salad and salmon over spinach and garbanzo beans. Sam was our server and made the experience perfect from start to finish. His suggestions and timing were spot on; with a great attitude toob. We shared a dessert - coconut flan with passion fruit sorbet. I'm so impressed  & couldn't ask for better! I can hardly wait to come back again.

I’ve been here several times, and it’s always been good, but today was exceptional thanks to Justin. Despite being incredibly busy, running between the bar and tables, he delivered excellent service with patience and attention to detail. After today, I truly understand what five-star service means, and it definitely goes to Justin. Thank you for pampering us and providing such outstanding service!

Came here for happy hour, stayed for dinner. We had a large party, and reservation was made for way less people than we ended up having. Service at the bar was fast and good.

Most importantly the happy hour here is amazing. I would say the best selection and prices that I have seen anywhere else! *Happy hour food applies only at the bar!
Will most definitely return!
Gladys was amazing! Super friendly and took great care of us. She made our dining experience really enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Frankly this is one of the best Spanish places we’ve tried in the US, and we travel a lot.
The staff is super well trained and organized. Make sure you make a reservation and, if Magic Dinners are available, take them.

We had a ton of stuff and you won’t be disappointed with anything, though we liked the croquetas (both ham and mushrooms), meat, flan, and churros the best.

We celebrated two anniversaries and will definitely be coming again (to get the paella) and recommending to others. For sure a must if in Winter Park.

Good place for Spanish-inspired tapas, but nothing is amazing. Maybe I'm just not a huge fan of Spanish food, but several items seemed too heavy or salty. My favorite were the montaditos. Service was friendly, and food came out at a good pace. Prices were a bit high for the quality.

We stopped by for the Labor Day brunch special, it was our first time here. Our server Ybar was great! The host was so nice as well, although I didn’t catch her name.
The $31pp prix fixe menu had a lot of great options but we finally decided on the watermelon salad, smoked salmon montaditos, steak & eggs, braised pork hash, torrija, and hazelnut waffles. Plus bottomless mimosa and a mango mule mocktail. Everything was delicious 😋
We will definitely be back!!

Great food and great service are a recipe for a great evening. Sam, Caroline and Frank were fabulous. They were fun, professional, made great drinks and were on top of our food and drinks orders. We had a very enjoyable evening with wonderful drinks and great tapas. The Moscow mule is awesome!

We shared a dessert - coconut flan with passion fruit sorbet. I'm so impressed  & couldn't ask for better! I can hardly wait to come back again.

I’ve been here several times, and it’s always been good, but today was exceptional thanks to Justin. Despite being incredibly busy, running between the bar and tables, he delivered excellent service with patience and attention to detail. After today, I truly understand what five-star service means, and it definitely goes to Justin. Thank you for pampering us and providing such outstanding service!

Came here for happy hour, stayed for dinner. We had a large party, and reservation was made for way less people than we ended up having. Management and staff went above and beyond to ensure we are taken care of and moved us to a larger table, during a peak rush hour with practically an entire restaurant being sat! 10/5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Service at the bar was fast and good.
Once we moved to the table, our server handled our party (12) by himself and was on top of refills and such! Food came out exactly how it was ordered. Super pleased with this experience.
Most importantly the happy hour here is amazing. I would say the best selection and prices that I have seen anywhere else! *Happy hour food applies only at the bar!
Will most definitely return!
Gladys was amazing! Super friendly and took great care of us. She made our dining experience really enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Frankly this is one of the best Spanish places we’ve tried in the US, and we travel a lot.
The staff is super well trained and organized. Make sure you make a reservation and, if Magic Dinners are available, take them.

We had a ton of stuff and you won’t be disappointed with anything, though we liked the croquetas (both ham and mushrooms), meat, flan, and churros the best.

We celebrated two anniversaries and will definitely be coming again (to get the paella) and recommending to others. For sure a must if in Winter Park.

We will definitely be back!!
